name: Can Engineered Hardwood Be Refinished? Check the Wear Layer (Sammamish Guide)
title-tag: Can Engineered Hardwood Be Refinished? Sammamish Guide
meta-description: Most engineered hardwood can be refinished once or twice — if the wear layer is 2mm+. How to measure yours in a Sammamish home before anyone sands.
post-summary: September 4, 2026 · Most engineered hardwood can be refinished — the answer lives in the wear layer. A Sammamish guide to measuring yours at a floor vent, the millimeter math that decides one refinish or two, and when a recoat is the only safe play on the plateau's 90s–2000s floors.
